build.description: Build a library into a publishable package.

e2e.description: Pack a library's build, install the tarball into the e2e project that tests it, and run its suites.

publish.description: Publish a library's build output to the npm registry, skipping a version already there.

test.description: Run a project's suites on Node's built-in test runner.

typecheck.description: Run the TypeScript compiler over a project without emitting files.
